title.zh: 卷七十七 志第二十七下: 祭祀六
title.raw: 卷七十七 志第二十七下: 祭祀六 Volume 77 Treatises 30: Offerings 6

sentences.zh: 祭祀六 ○至正親祀南郊

translations.literal: Offerings 6 ○ Zhizheng-era personal sacrifice at the Southern Altar
translations.idiomatic: Offerings 6 — The emperor's personal sacrifice at the Southern Altar in the Zhizheng era

sentences.zh: 至正三年十月十七日，親祀昊天上帝於圜丘，以太祖皇帝配享，如舊行儀制。

translations.literal: On the seventeenth day of the tenth month in the third year of Zhizheng, he personally sacrificed to the August Heaven at the Round Mound, with the founding emperor as associate in the offering, following the former ritual regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventeenth day of the tenth month in the third year of Zhizheng, the emperor in person sacrificed to the Supreme Deity at the Round Mound, with the founding emperor as associate, proceeding according to the established ritual code.

sentences.zh: 右丞相脫脫為亞獻官，太尉、樞密知院阿魯禿為終獻官，御史大夫伯撒裏為攝司徒，樞密知院汪家奴為大禮使，中書平章也先帖木兒、鐵木兒達識二人為侍中，御史大夫也先帖木兒、中書右丞太平二人為門下侍郎，宣徽使達世帖睦爾、太常同知李好文二人為禮儀使，宣徽院使也先帖木兒執劈正斧，其餘侍祀官依等第定擬。

translations.literal: The Right Grand Councillor Toghto served as secondary offering official; the Grand Marshal and Privy Council Commissioner Arut served as final offering official; the Censor-in-Chief Barsari served as acting Chancellor of Ceremonies; the Privy Council Commissioner Wangjianu served as Grand Master of Ceremonies; the Secretariat Grand Councillors Yesian Temur and Temur Dash served as Masters of Ceremonies; the Censor-in-Chief Yesian Temur and the Secretariat Right Vice Councillor Taiping served as Vice Directors of the Imperial Secretariat; the Court of Imperial Treasury Commissioner Dash Temur and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Associate Director Li Haowen served as Masters of Ritual; the Court of Imperial Treasury Director Yesian Temur held the ceremonial axe; the remaining attendant sacrifice officials were assigned by rank.
translations.idiomatic: The right grand councillor Toghto served as secondary offering official; the grand marshal and privy council commissioner Arut as final offering official; the censor-in-chief Barsari as acting chancellor of ceremonies; the privy council commissioner Wangjianu as grand master of ceremonies; the secretariat grand councillors Yesian Temur and Temur Dash as masters of ceremony; the censor-in-chief Yesian Temur and the secretariat right vice councillor Taiping as vice directors of the imperial secretariat; the court of imperial treasury commissioner Dash Temur and the court of imperial sacrifices associate director Li Haowen as masters of ritual; the court of imperial treasury director Yesian Temur held the ceremonial axe; and the remaining attendant sacrifice officials were assigned according to rank.

sentences.zh: 前期八月初七日，太常禮儀院移關禮部，具呈都省，會集翰林、集賢、禮部等官，講究典禮。

translations.literal: On the seventh day of the eighth month beforehand, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ceremonies sent a formal notice to the Ministry of Rites, submitted a memorial to the Metropolitan Secretariat, and convened officials of the Hanlin Academy, the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, the Ministry of Rites, and others to deliberate on the canonical rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh day of the eighth month in advance, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ceremonies notified the Ministry of Rites, submitted a report to the metropolitan secretariat, and convened officials from the Hanlin Academy, the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, the Ministry of Rites, and other offices to work out the canonical rites.

sentences.zh: 九月內，承奉班都知孫玉鉉具錄《親祀南郊儀註》云：致齋日停奏刑殺文字，應享執事官員蒞誓於中書省。

translations.literal: Within the ninth month, Sun Yuxuan, Director of the Imperial Attendance Corps, fully recorded the Regulations for the Personal Sacrifice at the Southern Altar, stating: On the day of purification abstention, memorials concerning capital punishment were to cease; the officials who would perform the sacrifice were to assemble for the oath at the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: During the ninth month, Sun Yuxuan, director of the imperial attendance corps, compiled the full text of the Regulations for the Personal Sacrifice at the Southern Altar, which stipulated that on the purification day memorials concerning capital punishment were to cease, and that the officials assigned to perform the sacrifice were to assemble for the oath at the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 享前一日質明，所司備法駕儀仗暨侍享官分左右敘立於崇天門外，太僕卿控御馬立於大明門外，侍儀官、導駕官各具公服，備擎執，立於致齋殿前。

translations.literal: At dawn on the day before the offering, the responsible offices prepared the imperial carriage with full regalia and ceremonial guards, and the attendant offering officials were arrayed left and right outside the Gate of Veneration of Heaven; the Director of the Imperial Stud held the imperial horses outside the Gate of Great Brilliance; the ceremonial attendants and carriage guides each wore official dress, held their ceremonial implements, and stood before the Purification Hall.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on the day before the offering, the responsible offices prepared the imperial carriage with full regalia and ceremonial guards, while attendant offering officials were drawn up in order to the left and right outside the Gate of Veneration of Heaven. The director of the imperial stud held the imperial horses outside the Gate of Great Brilliance, and the ceremonial attendants and carriage guides, each in official dress and bearing their ceremonial implements, stood before the Purification Hall.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人二員引門下侍郎、侍中入殿相向立。

translations.literal: Two Imperial Secretariat Attendants led the Vice Directors of the Imperial Secretariat and the Masters of Ceremonies into the hall and they stood facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: Two imperial secretariat attendants led the vice directors of the imperial secretariat and the masters of ceremony into the hall, where they stood facing one another.

sentences.zh: 侍中跪奏請皇帝中嚴，就拜興，退出。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor enter strict seclusion; then he bowed and rose and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony knelt and reported, requesting that the emperor enter strict seclusion; he then bowed, rose, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 少頃，引侍中跪奏外辦，就拜興。

translations.literal: After a short while, he led the Master of Ceremonies to kneel and memorialize that preparations outside were complete; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, he led the master of ceremony to kneel and report that preparations outside were complete, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 皇帝出致齋殿，侍中跪奏請皇帝升輿，侍儀官、導駕官引擎執前導，巡輦路至大明殿西陛下。

translations.literal: The emperor emerged from the Purification Hall; the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor mount the palanquin; the ceremonial attendants and carriage guides took up their ceremonial implements and went before as guides, proceeding along the imperial route to the western steps of the Hall of Great Brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor left the Purification Hall, and the master of ceremony knelt and asked him to mount the palanquin. The ceremonial attendants and carriage guides took up their implements and went ahead as guides, following the imperial route to the western steps of the Hall of Great Brilliance.

sentences.zh: 侍中跪奏請皇帝降輿升殿，就拜興。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor descend from the palanquin and ascend the hall; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to descend from the palanquin and ascend the hall, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 皇帝入殿，即御座。

translations.literal: The emperor entered the hall and immediately took the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor entered the hall and took his seat at once.

sentences.zh: 舍人引執事等官，敘於殿午陛下，相向立。

translations.literal: The Attendants led the officiating officials and others to take their places at the southern steps of the hall and stand facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: The attendants led the officiating officials and others into position at the southern steps of the hall, where they stood facing one another.

sentences.zh: 通班舍人贊起居，引班鞠躬平身。

translations.literal: The Attendant who announced the assembly praised the salutation; the leading ranks bowed and straightened up.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant who announced the assembly called for the salutation, and the leading ranks bowed and straightened up.

sentences.zh: 舍人引門下侍郎、侍中入殿至御座前，門下侍郎、侍中相向立。

translations.literal: The Attendants led the Vice Directors of the Imperial Secretariat and the Masters of Ceremonies into the hall before the imperial seat; the Vice Directors and Masters of Ceremonies stood facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: The attendants led the vice directors of the imperial secretariat and the masters of ceremony into the hall before the imperial seat, where they stood facing one another.

sentences.zh: 侍中跪奏請皇帝降殿升輿，就拜興。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor descend from the hall and mount the palanquin; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to descend from the hall and mount the palanquin, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 侍儀官前導，至大明殿門外，侍中跪奏請皇帝升輿，就拜興。

translations.literal: The ceremonial attendants went before as guides; when they reached outside the gate of the Hall of Great Brilliance, the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor mount the palanquin; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial attendants went ahead as guides. At the outer gate of the Hall of Great Brilliance, the master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to mount the palanquin, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 至大明門外，侍中跪奏請皇帝降輿乘馬，門下侍郎跪奏請車駕進發，就拜興，動稱警蹕。

translations.literal: At the outside of the Gate of Great Brilliance, the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor descend from the palanquin and mount a horse; the Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession advance; then he bowed and rose, and at each movement the imperial guard was announced.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the Gate of Great Brilliance, the master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to dismount the palanquin and take a horse. The vice director of the imperial secretariat knelt and asked the imperial procession to advance, then bowed and rose; at each movement the imperial guard was announced.

sentences.zh: 至崇天門外，門下侍郎跪奏請車駕少駐，敕眾官上馬，就拜興。

translations.literal: At the outside of the Gate of Veneration of Heaven, the Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession halt briefly and commanding all officials to mount horses; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the Gate of Veneration of Heaven, the vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to halt briefly and commanded all officials to mount their horses, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 侍中承旨，退稱曰「制可」，門下侍郎退傳制，敕眾官上馬，贊者承傳，敕眾官於欞星門外上馬。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies received the imperial command, withdrew, and announced "The decree is approved"; the Vice Director withdrew and transmitted the decree, commanding all officials to mount horses; the announcer received and transmitted it, commanding all officials to mount horses outside the Lattice Star Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony received the imperial command, withdrew, and announced, "The decree is approved." The vice director withdrew and transmitted the decree, commanding all officials to mount their horses; the announcer received and relayed the command that all officials were to mount outside the Lattice Star Gate.

sentences.zh: 少頃，門下侍郎跪奏請車駕進發，就拜興，動稱警蹕。

translations.literal: After a short while, the Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession advance; then he bowed and rose, and at each movement the imperial guard was announced.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, the vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to advance, then bowed and rose; at each movement the imperial guard was announced.

sentences.zh: 華蓋傘扇儀仗百官左右前導，教坊樂鼓吹不作。

translations.literal: The ceremonial umbrellas, fans, regalia, and officials of all ranks went before to left and right as guides; the music and drums of the Court Entertainment Office did not sound.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial umbrellas, fans, regalia, and officials of all ranks went ahead to the left and right as guides, while the music and drums of the Court Entertainment Office remained silent.

sentences.zh: 至郊壇南欞星門外，門下侍郎跪奏請皇帝權停，敕眾官下馬。

translations.literal: At the outside of the southern Lattice Star Gate of the suburban altar, the Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor halt temporarily and commanding all officials to dismount.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the southern Lattice Star Gate of the suburban altar, the vice director knelt and asked the emperor to halt briefly and commanded all officials to dismount.

sentences.zh: 侍中傳制，敕眾官下馬，自卑而尊與儀仗倒卷而北，左右駐立。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies transmitted the decree, commanding all officials to dismount; from the lower to the higher ranks, together with the ceremonial regalia, they rolled back northward and stood at left and right.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony transmitted the decree commanding all officials to dismount. From lower to higher rank, together with the ceremonial regalia, they folded back northward and took up stations to the left and right.

sentences.zh: 駕至內欞星門，侍中跪奏請皇帝降馬，步入欞星門，由右偏門入。

translations.literal: When the imperial procession reached the inner Lattice Star Gate, the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor dismount and walk into the Lattice Star Gate, entering by the right side gate.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial procession reached the inner Lattice Star Gate, the master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to dismount and walk through the Lattice Star Gate, entering by the right side gate.

sentences.zh: 稍西，侍中跪奏請皇帝升輿，就拜興。

translations.literal: A little farther west, the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor mount the palanquin; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: A little farther west, the master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to mount the palanquin, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 侍儀官暨導駕官引擎執前導，至大次殿門前，侍中跪奏請皇帝降輿，入就大次殿，就拜興。

translations.literal: The ceremonial attendants and carriage guides took up their ceremonial implements and went before as guides; when they reached before the gate of the Great Resting Hall, the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor descend from the palanquin and enter the Great Resting Hall; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial attendants and carriage guides took up their implements and went ahead as guides. At the gate of the Great Resting Hall, the master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to descend from the palanquin and enter the Great Resting Hall, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 皇帝入就大次，簾降，宿衛如式。

translations.literal: The emperor entered and took his place in the Great Resting Hall; the curtains were lowered and the night guard was posted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor entered the Great Resting Hall and took his place; the curtains were lowered and the night guard was posted according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 侍中入跪奏，敕眾官各退齋次，就拜興。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies entered, knelt, and memorialized, commanding all officials each to withdraw to their purification quarters; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony entered, knelt, and reported, commanding all officials to withdraw to their purification quarters, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人承旨，敕眾官各還齋次。

translations.literal: The Imperial Secretariat Attendant received the command and directed all officials each to return to their purification quarters.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial secretariat attendant received the command and directed all officials to return to their purification quarters.

sentences.zh: 尚食進膳訖，禮儀使以祝冊奏禦署訖，奉出，郊祀令受而奠於坫。

translations.literal: When the Imperial Kitchen had finished presenting the meal, the Master of Ritual presented the prayer text for the emperor's signature; when this was completed, it was brought out and received by the Director of Suburban Sacrifices, who placed it on the altar mound.
translations.idiomatic: After the imperial kitchen had finished presenting the meal, the master of ritual presented the prayer text for the emperor's signature. When this was done, it was brought out and received by the director of suburban sacrifices, who placed it on the altar mound.

sentences.zh: 其享日丑時二刻，侍儀官備擎執，同導駕官列於大次殿前。

translations.literal: On the day of the offering, at the second quarter of the chou hour, the ceremonial attendants prepared their ceremonial implements and, together with the carriage guides, were arrayed before the Great Resting Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of the offering, at the second quarter of the chou hour, the ceremonial attendants prepared their implements and, together with the carriage guides, were drawn up before the Great Resting Hall.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引侍中、門下侍郎入大次殿。

translations.literal: The Imperial Secretariat Attendant led the Master of Ceremonies and the Vice Directors into the Great Resting Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial secretariat attendant led the master of ceremony and the vice directors into the Great Resting Hall.

sentences.zh: 侍中跪奏請皇帝中嚴，服袞冕，就拜興，退。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor enter strict seclusion and don the dark ceremonial robes and cap; then he bowed and rose and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to enter strict seclusion and don the dark ceremonial robes and cap, then bowed, rose, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 少頃，舍人再拜引侍中跪版奏外辦，就拜興，退出。

translations.literal: After a short while, the Attendant bowed twice and led the Master of Ceremonies to kneel and memorialize on the memorial board that preparations outside were complete; then he bowed and rose and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, the attendant bowed twice and led the master of ceremony to kneel and report on the memorial board that preparations outside were complete, then bowed, rose, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使入跪奏皇帝行禮，就拜興。

translations.literal: The Master of Ritual entered, knelt, and memorialized that the emperor should perform the rites; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ritual entered, knelt, and reported that the emperor should perform the rites, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 簾卷出大次，侍儀官備擎執，同導駕官前導。

translations.literal: The curtains were raised and he emerged from the Great Resting Hall; the ceremonial attendants prepared their ceremonial implements and, together with the carriage guides, went before as guides.
translations.idiomatic: The curtains were raised and the emperor emerged from the Great Resting Hall. The ceremonial attendants prepared their implements and, together with the carriage guides, went ahead as guides.

sentences.zh: 皇帝至西壝門，侍儀官、導駕官擎執止於壝門外，近侍官、代禮官皆後從入。

translations.literal: When the emperor reached the western spirit wall gate, the ceremonial attendants and carriage guides holding their implements halted outside the spirit wall gate; the close attendants and substitute ritual officials all followed behind and entered.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor reached the western spirit wall gate, the ceremonial attendants and carriage guides halted outside the gate with their implements, while the close attendants and substitute ritual officials all followed behind and entered.

sentences.zh: 殿中監跪進大圭，禮儀使跪請皇帝執大圭，皇帝入行禮，禮節一如舊制。

translations.literal: The Director of the Palace Interior knelt and presented the great jade tablet; the Master of Ritual knelt and requested that the emperor take the great jade tablet; the emperor entered to perform the rites, and the ritual proceedings were exactly as in the former regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the palace interior knelt and presented the great jade tablet. The master of ritual knelt and asked the emperor to take it, and the emperor entered to perform the rites according to the established ritual code.

sentences.zh: 行禮畢，侍儀官備擎執，同導駕官前導，皇帝還至大次。

translations.literal: When the rites were completed, the ceremonial attendants prepared their ceremonial implements and, together with the carriage guides, went before as guides, and the emperor returned to the Great Resting Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were completed, the ceremonial attendants prepared their implements and, together with the carriage guides, went ahead as guides while the emperor returned to the Great Resting Hall.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引侍中入跪奏，請皇帝解嚴，釋袞冕。

translations.literal: The Imperial Secretariat Attendant led the Master of Ceremonies in; he knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor end strict seclusion and remove the dark ceremonial robes and cap.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial secretariat attendant led the master of ceremony in; he knelt and asked the emperor to end strict seclusion and remove the dark ceremonial robes and cap.

sentences.zh: 停五刻頃，尚食進膳如儀。

translations.literal: After a pause of about five quarters of an hour, the Imperial Kitchen presented the meal according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: After a pause of about five quarters of an hour, the imperial kitchen presented the meal according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 所司備法駕儀仗，同侍享等官分左右，敘立於郊南欞星門外，以北為上。

translations.literal: The responsible offices prepared the imperial carriage with full regalia and ceremonial guards; together with the attendant offering officials and others, they were arrayed left and right outside the southern Lattice Star Gate of the suburb, with north as the superior position.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices prepared the imperial carriage with full regalia and ceremonial guards. Together with the attendant offering officials and others, they were drawn up to the left and right outside the southern Lattice Star Gate of the suburb, with north as the superior position.

sentences.zh: 舍人引侍中入跪奏，請皇帝中嚴，就拜興，退。

translations.literal: The Attendant led the Master of Ceremonies in; he knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor enter strict seclusion; then he bowed and rose and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant led the master of ceremony in; he knelt and asked the emperor to enter strict seclusion, then bowed, rose, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 少頃，再引侍中跪版奏外辦，就拜興。

translations.literal: After a short while, he again led the Master of Ceremonies to kneel and memorialize on the memorial board that preparations outside were complete; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, he again led the master of ceremony to kneel and report on the memorial board that preparations outside were complete, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 皇帝出大次，侍中跪奏請皇帝升輿，侍儀官備擎執，同導駕官前導，至欞星門外，太僕卿進御馬，侍中跪奏請皇帝降輿乘馬，就拜興。

translations.literal: The emperor emerged from the Great Resting Hall; the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor mount the palanquin; the ceremonial attendants prepared their ceremonial implements and, together with the carriage guides, went before as guides; when they reached outside the Lattice Star Gate, the Director of the Imperial Stud presented the imperial horse; the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor descend from the palanquin and mount a horse; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor left the Great Resting Hall, and the master of ceremony knelt and asked him to mount the palanquin. The ceremonial attendants prepared their implements and, together with the carriage guides, went ahead as guides. Outside the Lattice Star Gate, the director of the imperial stud presented the imperial horse, and the master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to dismount the palanquin and take a horse, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 門下侍郎跪奏請車駕進發，就拜興，動稱警蹕。

translations.literal: The Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession advance; then he bowed and rose, and at each movement the imperial guard was announced.
translations.idiomatic: The vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to advance, then bowed and rose; at each movement the imperial guard was announced.

sentences.zh: 至欞星門外，門下侍郎跪請皇帝少駐，敕眾官上馬，就拜興。

translations.literal: At the outside of the Lattice Star Gate, the Vice Director knelt and requested that the emperor halt briefly and commanded all officials to mount horses; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the Lattice Star Gate, the vice director knelt and asked the emperor to halt briefly and commanded all officials to mount their horses, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 侍中承旨退稱曰「制可」，門下侍郎傳制，敕眾官上馬，贊者承傳，敕眾官上馬。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies received the command, withdrew, and announced "The decree is approved"; the Vice Director transmitted the decree, commanding all officials to mount horses; the announcer received and transmitted it, commanding all officials to mount horses.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony received the command, withdrew, and announced, "The decree is approved." The vice director transmitted the decree commanding all officials to mount their horses, and the announcer received and relayed the command.

sentences.zh: 少頃，門下侍郎跪奏請車駕進發，就拜興。

translations.literal: After a short while, the Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession advance; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, the vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to advance, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 侍儀官備擎執，同導駕官前導，動稱警蹕，華蓋儀仗傘扇眾官左右前導，教坊樂鼓吹皆作。

translations.literal: The ceremonial attendants prepared their ceremonial implements and, together with the carriage guides, went before as guides; at each movement the imperial guard was announced; the ceremonial umbrellas, regalia, fans, and officials of all ranks went before to left and right as guides; the music and drums of the Court Entertainment Office all sounded.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial attendants prepared their implements and, together with the carriage guides, went ahead as guides; at each movement the imperial guard was announced. Ceremonial umbrellas, regalia, fans, and officials of all ranks went ahead to the left and right, and the music and drums of the Court Entertainment Office all sounded.

sentences.zh: 至麗正門裏石橋北，舍人引門下侍郎下馬，跪奏請皇帝權停，敕眾官下馬，贊者承傳，敕眾官下馬，舍人引眾官分左右，先入紅門內，倒卷而北駐立。

translations.literal: North of the stone bridge inside the Gate of Beautiful Rectitude, the Attendant led the Vice Director to dismount; he knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor halt temporarily and commanding all officials to dismount; the announcer received and transmitted it, commanding all officials to dismount; the Attendant led all officials to left and right, entering first inside the Red Gate, rolling back northward and standing in place.
translations.idiomatic: North of the stone bridge inside the Gate of Beautiful Rectitude, the attendant led the vice director to dismount and knelt, asking the emperor to halt briefly and commanding all officials to dismount. The announcer relayed the command, and the attendant led the officials to the left and right to enter first inside the Red Gate, where they folded back northward and took up station.

sentences.zh: 引甲馬軍士於麗正門內石橋大北駐立，依次倒卷至欞星門外，左右相向立。

translations.literal: He led the armored cavalry soldiers to stand in place far north of the stone bridge inside the Gate of Beautiful Rectitude; in order they rolled back to outside the Lattice Star Gate and stood facing one another at left and right.
translations.idiomatic: He led the armored cavalry soldiers to take station far north of the stone bridge inside the Gate of Beautiful Rectitude, then in order they folded back to outside the Lattice Star Gate and stood facing one another to the left and right.

sentences.zh: 仗立於欞星門內，倒卷亦如之。

translations.literal: The ceremonial guards stood inside the Lattice Star Gate, rolling back in the same manner.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial guards stood inside the Lattice Star Gate and folded back in the same manner.

sentences.zh: 門下侍郎跪奏請車駕進發，侍儀官備擎執，導駕官導由崇天門入，至大明門外。

translations.literal: The Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession advance; the ceremonial attendants prepared their ceremonial implements; the carriage guides led through the Gate of Veneration of Heaven and in to the outside of the Gate of Great Brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: The vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to advance. The ceremonial attendants prepared their implements, and the carriage guides led through the Gate of Veneration of Heaven to the outside of the Gate of Great Brilliance.

sentences.zh: 引侍中跪奏請皇帝降馬升輿，就拜興。

translations.literal: He led the Master of Ceremonies to kneel and memorialized, requesting that the emperor dismount and mount the palanquin; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: He led the master of ceremony to kneel and ask the emperor to dismount and mount the palanquin, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 至大明殿，引眾官相向立於殿陛下。

translations.literal: When they reached the Hall of Great Brilliance, he led all officials to stand facing one another at the steps of the hall.
translations.idiomatic: At the Hall of Great Brilliance, he led all officials to stand facing one another at the steps of the hall.

sentences.zh: 俟皇帝入殿升座，侍中跪奏請皇帝解嚴，敕眾官皆退，通事舍人承旨敕眾官皆退，郊祀禮成。

translations.literal: When the emperor had entered the hall and ascended to his seat, the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor end strict seclusion and commanding all officials to withdraw; the Imperial Secretariat Attendant received the command and directed all officials to withdraw; the suburban sacrifice rites were completed.
translations.idiomatic: After the emperor had entered the hall and taken his seat, the master of ceremony knelt and asked him to end strict seclusion and commanded all officials to withdraw. The imperial secretariat attendant received the command and directed all officials to withdraw, and the suburban sacrifice rites were completed.

sentences.zh: 至正親祀太廟

translations.literal: Zhizheng-era personal sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's personal sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple in the Zhizheng era

sentences.zh: 至元六年六月，監察御史呈：「嘗聞《五行傳曰》，簡宗廟，廢祭祀，則水不潤下。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year of Zhiyuan, a surveillance censor submitted: "I have heard that the Commentary on the Five Processes says: If one simplifies the ancestral temple and abolishes sacrifices, then water will not moisten downward.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the sixth year of Zhiyuan, a surveillance censor submitted: "I have heard that the Commentary on the Five Processes says that if one simplifies the ancestral temple and abolishes sacrifices, then water will not moisten downward.

sentences.zh: 近年雨澤愆期，四方多旱，而歲減祀事，變更成憲，原其所致，恐有感召。

translations.literal: In recent years rain and moisture have been untimely, drought has been widespread in all directions, yet each year sacrificial affairs have been reduced and established statutes altered; tracing what has brought this about, I fear there may be a responsive summons.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years rain has come untimely and drought has spread in all directions, yet each year sacrificial affairs have been reduced and established statutes altered. Tracing what has brought this about, I fear there may be a responsive summons from Heaven.

sentences.zh: 欽惟國家四海乂安，百有餘年，列聖相承，典禮具備，莫不以孝治天下。

translations.literal: Respectfully considering that the state has had peace within the four seas for more than a hundred years, successive sage emperors have followed one another, canonical rites are fully provided, and none have failed to govern the realm through filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully considering that the state has enjoyed peace within the four seas for more than a hundred years, successive sage emperors have followed one another, canonical rites are fully in place, and none have failed to govern the realm through filial piety.

sentences.zh: 古者宗廟四時之祭，皆天子親享，莫敢使有司攝也。

translations.literal: In antiquity the seasonal sacrifices at the ancestral temple were all personally enjoyed by the Son of Heaven, and none dared have the responsible officials perform them by proxy.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity the seasonal sacrifices at the ancestral temple were all personally performed by the Son of Heaven, and none dared have responsible officials perform them by proxy.

sentences.zh: 蓋天子之職，莫大於禮，禮莫大於孝，孝莫大於祭。

translations.literal: For the Son of Heaven's duty, nothing is greater than ritual; of ritual nothing is greater than filial piety; of filial piety nothing is greater than sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: For the Son of Heaven's duty, nothing is greater than ritual; of ritual nothing is greater than filial piety; and of filial piety nothing is greater than sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 世祖皇帝自新都城，首建太廟，可謂知所本矣。

translations.literal: When the Shizu Emperor established the new capital, he first built the Imperial Ancestral Temple—this may be called knowing one's foundation.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shizu Emperor established the new capital, he first built the Imperial Ancestral Temple—this may truly be called knowing one's foundation.

sentences.zh: 《春秋》之法，國君即位，逾年改元，必行告廟之禮。

translations.literal: According to the method of the Spring and Autumn Annals, when a ruler of the state acceded, after a year he changed the era name and invariably performed the rite of announcing at the temple.
translations.idiomatic: According to the method of the Spring and Autumn Annals, when a ruler of the state acceded, after a year he changed the era name and invariably performed the rite of announcing his accession at the temple.

sentences.zh: 伏自陛下即位以來，於今七年，未嘗躬詣太廟，似為闕典。

translations.literal: Prostrating myself, since Your Majesty's accession until now seven years have passed, and you have never in person proceeded to the Imperial Ancestral Temple—this seems a lapse in canonical observance.
translations.idiomatic: Prostrating myself, since Your Majesty's accession seven years have now passed, and you have never in person proceeded to the Imperial Ancestral Temple—this seems a lapse in canonical observance.

sentences.zh: 方今政化更新，並遵舊制，告廟之典，理宜新享。」

translations.literal: Now that government and transformation are being renewed and the former regulations are all followed, the canonical observance of announcing at the temple is by right to be newly performed."
translations.idiomatic: Now that government and transformation are being renewed and the former regulations are all followed, the canonical observance of announcing at the temple ought by right to be newly performed."

sentences.zh: 時帝在上都，臺臣以聞，奉旨若曰：「俟到大都，親自祭也。」

translations.literal: At that time the emperor was at Shangdu; the censorial officials reported it, and an imperial command was received saying: "When I arrive at Dadu, I shall sacrifice in person."
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor was at Shangdu; the censorial officials reported it, and an imperial command was received saying, "When I arrive at Dadu, I shall sacrifice in person."

sentences.zh: 九月二十七日，中書省奏以十月初四日皇帝親祀太廟，制曰：「可。」

translations.literal: On the twenty-seventh day of the ninth month, the Secretariat memorialized that on the fourth day of the tenth month the emperor would personally sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the decree said: "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-seventh day of the ninth month, the Secretariat memorialized that on the fourth day of the tenth month the emperor would personally sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple. The decree said, "Approved."

sentences.zh: 前期，告示以太師、右丞相馬紮兒臺為亞獻官，樞密知院阿魯禿為終獻官，知院潑皮、翰林承旨老章為助奠官，大司農愛牙赤為七祀獻官，侍中二人，門下侍郎二人，大禮使一人，執劈正斧一人，禮儀使四人，余各如故事。

translations.literal: Beforehand, a public notice appointed the Grand Preceptor and Right Grand Councillor Mazhatai as secondary offering official, the Privy Council Commissioner Arut as final offering official, the Commissioners Popi and Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Laozhang as assisting offering officials, the Minister of Agriculture Ayachi as offering official for the seven sacrifices, two Masters of Ceremonies, two Vice Directors of the Imperial Secretariat, one Grand Master of Ceremonies, one holder of the ceremonial axe, four Masters of Ritual, and the remainder according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In advance, a public notice appointed the grand preceptor and right grand councillor Mazhatai as secondary offering official, the privy council commissioner Arut as final offering official, the commissioners Popi and Hanlin academician-in-chief Laozhang as assisting offering officials, the minister of agriculture Ayachi as offering official for the seven sacrifices, two masters of ceremony, two vice directors of the imperial secretariat, one grand master of ceremonies, one holder of the ceremonial axe, four masters of ritual, and the remainder according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 有司具儀註云：享前一日質明，所司備法駕於崇天門外，侍儀官引擎執，同導駕官具公服，於致齋殿前左右分班侍立。

translations.literal: The responsible offices fully recorded the ritual regulations, stating: At dawn on the day before the offering, the responsible offices prepared the imperial carriage with full regalia outside the Gate of Veneration of Heaven; the ceremonial attendants took up their ceremonial implements; together with the carriage guides they wore official dress and stood in attendance in two ranks left and right before the Purification Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices compiled the ritual regulations, which stated that at dawn on the day before the offering, the responsible offices prepared the imperial carriage with full regalia outside the Gate of Veneration of Heaven. The ceremonial attendants took up their implements, and together with the carriage guides, in official dress, they stood in attendance in two ranks to the left and right before the Purification Hall.

sentences.zh: 承奉舍人引門下侍郎、侍中人殿門下，侍郎相向立，侍中跪奏臣某等官請皇帝中嚴，就拜興，退出。

translations.literal: The Imperial Attendance Attendant led the Vice Directors and Masters of Ceremonies inside beneath the hall gate; the Vice Directors stood facing one another; the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, "We your officials request that the emperor enter strict seclusion"; then he bowed and rose and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial attendance attendant led the vice directors and masters of ceremony inside beneath the hall gate. The vice directors stood facing one another, and the master of ceremony knelt and reported, "We your officials request that the emperor enter strict seclusion," then bowed, rose, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 少頃，引侍中版奏外辦，就拜興，退。

translations.literal: After a short while, he led the Master of Ceremonies to memorialize on the memorial board that preparations outside were complete; then he bowed and rose and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, he led the master of ceremony to report on the memorial board that preparations outside were complete, then bowed, rose, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 皇帝出齋室，侍中跪奏請皇帝升輿，巡輦路，由正門至大明殿酉陛下。

translations.literal: The emperor emerged from the purification chamber; the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor mount the palanquin; he proceeded along the imperial route from the main gate to the western steps of the Hall of Great Brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor left the purification chamber, and the master of ceremony knelt and asked him to mount the palanquin. He proceeded along the imperial route from the main gate to the western steps of the Hall of Great Brilliance.

sentences.zh: 侍中跪奏請皇帝降輿升殿，就拜興，引皇帝即御座。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor descend from the palanquin and ascend the hall; then he bowed and rose and led the emperor to take the imperial seat at once.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to descend from the palanquin and ascend the hall, then bowed and rose and led the emperor to take his seat at once.

sentences.zh: 執事官於午陛下起居訖，舍人引侍中、門下侍郎入殿，至禦榻前，門下侍郎相向立。

translations.literal: When the officiating officials at the southern steps had finished the salutation, the Attendant led the Master of Ceremonies and Vice Directors into the hall before the imperial couch; the Vice Directors stood facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: When the officiating officials at the southern steps had finished the salutation, the attendant led the master of ceremony and vice directors into the hall before the imperial couch, where the vice directors stood facing one another.

sentences.zh: 侍中跪奏請皇帝降殿升輿，就拜興，導至大明殿外。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor descend from the hall and mount the palanquin; then he bowed and rose and guided him to outside the Hall of Great Brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to descend from the hall and mount the palanquin, then bowed and rose and guided him to outside the Hall of Great Brilliance.

sentences.zh: 侍中跪奏請皇帝升輿，就拜興。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor mount the palanquin; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to mount the palanquin, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 至大明門外，太僕卿進御馬。

translations.literal: At the outside of the Gate of Great Brilliance, the Director of the Imperial Stud presented the imperial horse.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the Gate of Great Brilliance, the director of the imperial stud presented the imperial horse.

sentences.zh: 侍中跪奏請皇帝降輿乘馬訖，門下侍郎跪奏請車駕進發，就拜興，進發時稱警蹕。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor descend from the palanquin and finish mounting a horse; the Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession advance; then he bowed and rose; when the procession advanced the imperial guard was announced.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to dismount the palanquin and mount a horse. The vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to advance, then bowed and rose; as the procession advanced, the imperial guard was announced.

sentences.zh: 至崇天門外，門下侍郎跪奏請車駕少駐，敕眾官上馬，就拜興。

translations.literal: At the outside of the Gate of Veneration of Heaven, the Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession halt briefly and commanding all officials to mount horses; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the Gate of Veneration of Heaven, the vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to halt briefly and commanded all officials to mount their horses, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 侍中承旨退稱曰「制可」，贊者承傳，敕眾官上馬。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies received the command, withdrew, and announced "The decree is approved"; the announcer received and transmitted it, commanding all officials to mount horses.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony received the command, withdrew, and announced, "The decree is approved." The announcer received and relayed the command that all officials were to mount their horses.

sentences.zh: 少頃，門下侍郎跪奏請車駕進發，就拜興，進發時稱警蹕。

translations.literal: After a short while, the Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession advance; then he bowed and rose; when the procession advanced the imperial guard was announced.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, the vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to advance, then bowed and rose; as the procession advanced, the imperial guard was announced.

sentences.zh: 導至太廟外紅門內，門下侍郎跪奏請車駕權停，敕眾官下馬，就拜興。

translations.literal: They guided the procession to inside the Red Gate outside the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession halt temporarily and commanding all officials to dismount; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: They guided the procession to inside the Red Gate outside the Imperial Ancestral Temple. The vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to halt temporarily and commanded all officials to dismount, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 贊者承傳，敕眾官下馬。

translations.literal: The announcer received and transmitted it, commanding all officials to dismount.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer received and relayed the command that all officials were to dismount.

sentences.zh: 門下侍郎跪奏請車駕進發，至石橋南，侍中跪奏請皇帝下馬，步入神門，就拜興。

translations.literal: The Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession advance; when they reached south of the stone bridge, the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor dismount and walk into the spirit gate; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to advance. South of the stone bridge, the master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to dismount and walk into the spirit gate, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 皇帝下馬，侍儀官同導駕官前導，皇帝步入神門稍西，侍中跪奏請皇帝升輿，就拜興。

translations.literal: The emperor dismounted; the ceremonial attendants together with the carriage guides went before as guides; the emperor walked into the spirit gate a little to the west; the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor mount the palanquin; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dismounted, and the ceremonial attendants together with the carriage guides went ahead as guides. The emperor walked into the spirit gate a little to the west, and the master of ceremony knelt and asked him to mount the palanquin, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 至大次殿門前，侍中跪奏請皇帝降輿，入就大次，就拜興。

translations.literal: When they reached before the gate of the Great Resting Hall, the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor descend from the palanquin and enter the Great Resting Hall; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: At the gate of the Great Resting Hall, the master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to descend from the palanquin and enter the Great Resting Hall, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 簾降，宿衛如式。

translations.literal: The curtains were lowered and the night guard was posted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The curtains were lowered and the night guard was posted according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 侍中入跪奏，敕眾官各還齋次，承旨贊者承傳，敕眾官各還齋次，俟行禮時至丑時二刻頃，侍儀官備擎執，同導駕官於大次殿門前，舍人引侍中、門下侍郎入大次座前，侍中跪奏請皇帝中嚴，服袞冕，就拜興，退。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies entered, knelt, and memorialized, commanding all officials each to return to their purification quarters; the announcer who received the command transmitted it, commanding all officials each to return to their purification quarters; when the time for performing the rites arrived, at about the second quarter of the chou hour, the ceremonial attendants prepared their ceremonial implements and, together with the carriage guides, were at before the gate of the Great Resting Hall; the Attendant led the Master of Ceremonies and Vice Directors inside before the seat in the Great Resting Hall; the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor enter strict seclusion and don the dark ceremonial robes and cap; then he bowed and rose and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony entered, knelt, and commanded all officials to return to their purification quarters; the announcer who received the command relayed it. When the time for performing the rites arrived, at about the second quarter of the chou hour, the ceremonial attendants prepared their implements and, together with the carriage guides, stood before the gate of the Great Resting Hall. The attendant led the master of ceremony and vice directors inside before the seat in the Great Resting Hall, and the master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to enter strict seclusion and don the dark ceremonial robes and cap, then bowed, rose, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 少頃，再引侍中跪奏外辦，就拜興，退。

translations.literal: After a short while, he again led the Master of Ceremonies to kneel and memorialize that preparations outside were complete; then he bowed and rose and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, he again led the master of ceremony to kneel and report that preparations outside were complete, then bowed, rose, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使跪奏請皇帝行禮，侍儀官同導駕官導引皇帝至西神門，擎執侍儀官同導駕官止。

translations.literal: The Master of Ritual knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor perform the rites; the ceremonial attendants together with the carriage guides guided the emperor to the western spirit gate; the ceremonial attendants and carriage guides holding their implements halted.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ritual knelt and asked the emperor to perform the rites. The ceremonial attendants together with the carriage guides guided the emperor to the western spirit gate, where the attendants and guides holding their implements halted.

sentences.zh: 行禮畢，皇帝由西神門出，侍儀官備擎執，同導駕官引導皇帝還至大次。

translations.literal: When the rites were completed, the emperor emerged by the western spirit gate; the ceremonial attendants prepared their ceremonial implements and, together with the carriage guides, guided the emperor back to the Great Resting Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were completed, the emperor emerged by the western spirit gate. The ceremonial attendants prepared their implements and, together with the carriage guides, guided the emperor back to the Great Resting Hall.

sentences.zh: 舍人引侍中入跪奏，請皇帝解嚴，釋袞冕。

translations.literal: The Attendant led the Master of Ceremonies in; he knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor end strict seclusion and remove the dark ceremonial robes and cap.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant led the master of ceremony in; he knelt and asked the emperor to end strict seclusion and remove the dark ceremonial robes and cap.

sentences.zh: 尚食進膳如式畢，侍中跪版奏外辦，就拜興，退。

translations.literal: When the Imperial Kitchen had finished presenting the meal according to regulation, the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized on the memorial board that preparations outside were complete; then he bowed and rose and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: After the imperial kitchen had finished presenting the meal according to regulation, the master of ceremony knelt and reported on the memorial board that preparations outside were complete, then bowed, rose, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 導皇帝出大次，侍中跪奏請皇帝升輿，就拜興。

translations.literal: They guided the emperor out of the Great Resting Hall; the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor mount the palanquin; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: They guided the emperor out of the Great Resting Hall, and the master of ceremony knelt and asked him to mount the palanquin, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 侍儀官同導駕官前導，至神門外，太僕卿進御馬，侍中跪奏請皇帝降輿乘馬，就拜興。

translations.literal: The ceremonial attendants together with the carriage guides went before as guides; when they reached outside the spirit gate, the Director of the Imperial Stud presented the imperial horse; the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor descend from the palanquin and mount a horse; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial attendants together with the carriage guides went ahead as guides. Outside the spirit gate, the director of the imperial stud presented the imperial horse, and the master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to dismount the palanquin and take a horse, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 乘馬訖，門下侍郎跪奏請車駕進發，就拜興，退，進發時稱警蹕。

translations.literal: When he had finished mounting the horse, the Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession advance; then he bowed and rose and withdrew; when the procession advanced the imperial guard was announced.
translations.idiomatic: When he had finished mounting the horse, the vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to advance, then bowed, rose, and withdrew; as the procession advanced, the imperial guard was announced.

sentences.zh: 至欞星門外，門下侍郎跪奏請車駕少駐，敕眾官上馬，就拜興。

translations.literal: At the outside of the Lattice Star Gate, the Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession halt briefly and commanding all officials to mount horses; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the Lattice Star Gate, the vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to halt briefly and commanded all officials to mount their horses, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 侍中承旨退稱曰「制可」，贊者承傳，敕眾官上馬。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies received the command, withdrew, and announced "The decree is approved"; the announcer received and transmitted it, commanding all officials to mount horses.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony received the command, withdrew, and announced, "The decree is approved." The announcer received and relayed the command that all officials were to mount their horses.

sentences.zh: 少頃，門下侍郎跪奏請車駕進發，就拜興，進發時稱警蹕，教坊樂振作。

translations.literal: After a short while, the Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession advance; then he bowed and rose; when the procession advanced the imperial guard was announced, and the music of the Court Entertainment Office sounded.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, the vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to advance, then bowed and rose; as the procession advanced, the imperial guard was announced, and the music of the Court Entertainment Office sounded.

sentences.zh: 至麗正門裏石橋北，引門下侍郎跪奏請車駕權停，敕眾官下馬，就拜興。

translations.literal: North of the stone bridge inside the Gate of Beautiful Rectitude, he led the Vice Director to kneel and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession halt temporarily and commanding all officials to dismount; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: North of the stone bridge inside the Gate of Beautiful Rectitude, he led the vice director to kneel and ask the imperial procession to halt briefly and command all officials to dismount, then bow and rise.

sentences.zh: 贊者承傳，敕眾官下馬。

translations.literal: The announcer received and transmitted it, commanding all officials to dismount.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer received and relayed the command that all officials were to dismount.

sentences.zh: 門下侍郎跪奏請車駕進發，侍儀官引擎執，同導駕官前導，執事官後從，皇帝由紅門裏輦路至大明門外。

translations.literal: The Vice Director knelt and memorialized, requesting that the imperial procession advance; the ceremonial attendants held the ceremonial implements and, together with the carriage guides, went before as guides; the officiating officials followed behind; the emperor went from the carriage road inside the Red Gate to outside the Gate of Great Brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: The vice director knelt and asked the imperial procession to advance. The ceremonial attendants held their implements and, together with the carriage guides, went ahead as guides, while the officiating officials followed behind. The emperor proceeded from the carriage road inside the Red Gate to outside the Gate of Great Brilliance.

sentences.zh: 侍中跪奏請皇帝降馬乘輿，就拜興。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, requesting that the emperor dismount the horse and mount the palanquin; then he bowed and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony knelt and asked the emperor to dismount the horse and mount the palanquin, then bowed and rose.

sentences.zh: 侍儀官擎執，同導駕官導至大明殿，諸執事殿下相向立。

translations.literal: The ceremonial attendants held their ceremonial implements and, together with the carriage guides, guided him to the Hall of Great Brilliance; all the officiating officials stood facing one another below the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial attendants held their implements and, together with the carriage guides, guided him to the Hall of Great Brilliance, where all the officiating officials stood facing one another below the hall.

sentences.zh: 俟皇帝入殿升座，侍中跪奏敕眾官皆退，贊者承傳，敕眾官皆退。

translations.literal: When the emperor had entered the hall and ascended the throne, the Master of Ceremonies knelt and memorialized, commanding all officials to withdraw; the announcer received and transmitted it, commanding all officials to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor had entered the hall and ascended the throne, the master of ceremony knelt and commanded all officials to withdraw; the announcer received and relayed the command, and all officials withdrew.

sentences.zh: 三皇廟祭祀禮樂

translations.literal: Sacrificial Rites and Music at the Three Sovereigns Temple
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial Rites and Music at the Three Sovereigns Temple

sentences.zh: 至正九年，御史臺以江西湖東道肅政廉訪使文殊訥所言具呈中書。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhizheng, the Censorate fully memorialized to the Central Secretariat the proposal of Wenshunne, Commissioner for Upholding Justice and Investigative Visitation of the Jiangxi-Hudong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Zhizheng, the Censorate fully memorialized to the Central Secretariat the proposal of Wenshunne, commissioner for upholding justice and investigative visitation of the Jiangxi-Hudong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 其言曰：「三皇開天立極，功被萬世。

translations.literal: The memorial said: "The Three Sovereigns opened heaven and established the cosmic pole; their merit extends to ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial said: "The Three Sovereigns opened heaven and established the cosmic pole, and their merit extends to ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 京師每歲春秋祀事，命太醫官主祭，揆禮未稱。

translations.literal: Each year in the capital at the spring and autumn sacrifices, palace physicians were appointed to preside at the offering; when weighed against ritual propriety, this was inadequate.
translations.idiomatic: Each year in the capital at the spring and autumn sacrifices, palace physicians were appointed to preside at the offering — when weighed against ritual propriety, this was inadequate.

sentences.zh: 請如國子學、宣聖廟春秋釋奠，上遣中書省臣代祀，一切儀禮仿其制。」

translations.literal: We request that it follow the spring and autumn Ci Dian at the National University and Confucius Temple: that the court dispatch a member of the Central Secretariat to offer sacrifice on the emperor's behalf, with all ritual observances modeled on that precedent."
translations.idiomatic: We request that it follow the spring and autumn Ci Dian at the National University and Confucius Temple — that the court dispatch a member of the Central Secretariat to offer sacrifice on the emperor's behalf, with all ritual observances modeled on that precedent."

sentences.zh: 中書付禮部集禮官議之。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat entrusted the Ministry of Rites to convene ritual officials for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat entrusted the Ministry of Rites to convene ritual officials for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 是年十月二十四日，平章政事太不花、定住等以聞，制曰「可」。

translations.literal: On the twenty-fourth day of the tenth month of that year, the Grand Councillors Taibuhua, Dingzhu, and others reported this, and the decree read, "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-fourth day of the tenth month of that year, the grand councillors Taibuhua, Dingzhu, and others reported this, and the decree read, "Approved."

sentences.zh: 於是命太常定儀式，工部範祭器，江浙行省制雅樂器。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was ordered to fix the ritual protocol, the Ministry of Works to cast the sacrificial vessels, and the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat to manufacture the court ritual instruments.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was ordered to fix the ritual protocol, the Ministry of Works to cast the sacrificial vessels, and the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat to manufacture the court ritual instruments.

sentences.zh: 復命太常博士定樂曲名，翰林國史院撰樂章十有六曲。

translations.literal: They further ordered the Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to fix the names of the musical pieces, and the Hanlin Academy and National History Institute to compose sixteen hymn texts.
translations.idiomatic: They further ordered the doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to fix the names of the musical pieces, and the Hanlin Academy and National History Institute to compose sixteen hymn texts.

sentences.zh: 明年，祭器、樂器俱備，以醫籍百四十有八戶充廟戶禮樂生。

translations.literal: The following year, when sacrificial vessels and musical instruments were all ready, one hundred forty-eight households on the medical registry were assigned as temple households and ritual musicians.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, when sacrificial vessels and musical instruments were all ready, one hundred forty-eight households on the medical registry were assigned as temple households and ritual musicians.

sentences.zh: 禦藥院大使盧亨素習音律，受命教樂工四十有二人，各執其技，乃季秋九月九日蕆事。

translations.literal: Lu Heng, Director of the Imperial Pharmacy, who was well versed in music theory, was ordered to instruct forty-two musicians, each mastering his own art; the rites were then completed on the ninth day of the ninth month of late autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Heng, director of the Imperial Pharmacy, who was well versed in music theory, was ordered to instruct forty-two musicians, each mastering his own art; the rites were then completed on the ninth day of the ninth month of late autumn.

sentences.zh: 宣徽供禮饌，光祿勛供內醞，太府供金帛，廣源庫供薌炬，大興府尹供犧牲、制幣、粢盛、肴核。

translations.literal: The Office of Palace Provisions supplied ceremonial foods; the Office of Imperial Entertainment supplied imperial wine; the Office of the Imperial Storehouse supplied gold and silk; the Broad Revenue Storehouse supplied fragrant candles; the Prefect of Daxing supplied sacrificial animals, ceremonial silks, grain offerings, and dishes and fruits.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of Palace Provisions supplied ceremonial foods; the Office of Imperial Entertainment supplied imperial wine; the Office of the Imperial Storehouse supplied gold and silk; the Broad Revenue Storehouse supplied fragrant candles; and the prefect of Daxing supplied sacrificial animals, ceremonial silks, grain offerings, and dishes and fruits.

sentences.zh: 中書奏擬三獻官以次定，諸執事並以清望充。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat memorialized proposing the order of the three-offering officials, and all officiating roles were filled by men of eminent reputation.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat memorialized proposing the order of the three-offering officials, and all officiating roles were filled by men of eminent reputation.

sentences.zh: 前一日，內降禦香，三獻官以下公服備大樂儀仗迎香，至開天殿庋置。

translations.literal: On the day before, imperial incense was issued from within the palace; the three-offering officials and those below, in formal court dress and with great music and ceremonial regalia, welcomed the incense and placed it on a shelf in the Hall of Opening Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day before, imperial incense was issued from within the palace; the three-offering officials and those below, in formal court dress and with great music and ceremonial regalia, welcomed the incense and placed it on a shelf in the Hall of Opening Heaven.

sentences.zh: 退習明日祭儀，習畢就廟齋宿。

translations.literal: They withdrew to rehearse the next day's sacrificial protocol; when the rehearsal was finished, they lodged at the temple in purification.
translations.idiomatic: They withdrew to rehearse the next day's sacrificial protocol; when the rehearsal was finished, they lodged at the temple in purification.

sentences.zh: 京朝文武百司與祭官如之，各以禮助祭。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of all bureaus in the capital who were participating in the sacrifice did likewise, each assisting at the offering according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials of all bureaus in the capital who were participating in the sacrifice did likewise, each assisting at the offering according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 翰林詞臣具祝文，曰「皇帝敬遣某官某致祭」。

translations.literal: Hanlin scholars prepared the prayer text, reading, "The emperor reverently sends Official So-and-so to perform the sacrifice."
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin scholars prepared the prayer text, reading, "The emperor reverently sends Official So-and-so to perform the sacrifice."

translations.idiomatic: Hymn Texts

translations.idiomatic: (The hymn texts for sacrifices to the altars of soil and grain in the previous fascicle are all in the ritual and music category; they are appended here.)

sentences.zh: 降神，奏《咸成之曲》：黃鐘宮三成

translations.literal: At the descent of the spirit, "The Accomplishment of All" was performed: Yellow Bell mode, three movements.
translations.idiomatic: At the descent of the spirit, "The Accomplishment of All" was performed: Yellow Bell mode, three movements.

sentences.zh: 於皇三聖，神化無方。

translations.literal: How august the Three Sages — their divine transformations know no bounds.
translations.idiomatic: How august the Three Sages — their divine transformations know no bounds.

sentences.zh: 繼天立極，垂憲百王。

translations.literal: They succeeded heaven and established the cosmic pole, bequeathing standards to a hundred kings.
translations.idiomatic: They succeeded heaven and established the cosmic pole, bequeathing standards to a hundred kings.

sentences.zh: 聿崇明祀，率由舊章。

translations.literal: Reverently they exalt bright sacrifice, all according to ancient rites.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently they exalt bright sacrifice, all according to ancient rites.

sentences.zh: 靈兮來下，休有烈光。

translations.literal: O spirits, descend — resplendent with glorious light.
translations.idiomatic: O spirits, descend — resplendent with glorious light.

sentences.zh: 降神，奏《賓成之曲》：大呂角二成

translations.literal: At the descent of the spirit, "The Guest's Accomplishment" was performed: Greater Lu mode in jue, two movements.
translations.idiomatic: At the descent of the spirit, "The Guest's Accomplishment" was performed: Greater Lu mode in jue, two movements.

sentences.zh: 帝德在人，日用不知。

translations.literal: The emperor's virtue is in the people — daily enjoyed, yet never recognized.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's virtue is in the people — daily enjoyed, yet never recognized.

sentences.zh: 神之在天，矧可度思。

translations.literal: How much more the spirits in heaven — who could measure and contemplate them?
translations.idiomatic: How much more the spirits in heaven — who could measure and contemplate them?

sentences.zh: 辰良日吉，蕆事有儀。

translations.literal: The day is auspicious, the hour propitious — to complete the rite with proper ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The day is auspicious, the hour propitious — to complete the rite with proper ceremony.

sentences.zh: 感以至誠，尚右享之。

translations.literal: Moved by utmost sincerity, may He above accept the offering.
translations.idiomatic: Moved by utmost sincerity, may He above accept the offering.

sentences.zh: 降神，奏《顧成之曲》：太簇徵二成

translations.literal: At the descent of the spirit, "The Gazing Accomplishment" was performed: Greater Cluster mode in zhi, two movements.
translations.idiomatic: At the descent of the spirit, "The Gazing Accomplishment" was performed: Greater Cluster mode in zhi, two movements.

sentences.zh: 大道之行，肇自古先。

translations.literal: The Way's progress began from ancient times.
translations.idiomatic: The Way's progress began from ancient times.

sentences.zh: 功烈所加，何千萬年。

translations.literal: The merit and achievements conferred — for how many thousands of myriads of years?
translations.idiomatic: The merit and achievements conferred — for how many thousands of myriads of years?

sentences.zh: 是尊是奉，執事孔虔。

translations.literal: Honored and revered, the officiants are profoundly reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Honored and revered, the officiants are profoundly reverent.

sentences.zh: 神哉沛兮，泠風馺然。

translations.literal: How abundant the spirit — cool breezes stir softly.
translations.idiomatic: How abundant the spirit — cool breezes stir softly.

sentences.zh: 降神，奏《臨成之曲》：應鐘羽二成

translations.literal: At the descent of the spirit, "The Approach Accomplishment" was performed: Responding Bell mode in yu, two movements.
translations.idiomatic: At the descent of the spirit, "The Approach Accomplishment" was performed: Responding Bell mode in yu, two movements.

sentences.zh: 雅奏告成，神斯降格。

translations.literal: The elegant music announces completion — the spirit now descends.
translations.idiomatic: The elegant music announces completion — the spirit now descends.

sentences.zh: 妥安有位，清廟奕奕。

translations.literal: Peacefully settled in its place, the pure temple shines bright.
translations.idiomatic: Peacefully settled in its place, the pure temple shines bright.

sentences.zh: 蚃潛通，豐融烜赫。

translations.literal: Subtle connections communicate in secret — abundant blessings blaze brilliantly.
translations.idiomatic: Subtle connections communicate in secret — abundant blessings blaze brilliantly.

sentences.zh: 我其承之，百世無斁。

translations.literal: May we receive them — for a hundred generations without end.
translations.idiomatic: May we receive them — for a hundred generations without end.

translations.literal: At the first offering's hand-washing, "The Purifying Accomplishment" was performed: Fair Washing mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the first offering's hand-washing, "The Purifying Accomplishment" was performed: Fair Washing mode.

sentences.zh: 靈斿戾止，式燕以寧。

translations.literal: The spirit's banners have arrived and halted — feasting thus brings tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit's banners have arrived and halted — feasting thus brings tranquility.

sentences.zh: 吉蠲致享，惟寅惟清。

translations.literal: Auspicious purification for the offering — earnest and pure.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious purification for the offering — earnest and pure.

translations.literal: Drawing from that vessel and pouring into this — rinsing hands and ascending.
translations.idiomatic: Drawing from that vessel and pouring into this — rinsing hands and ascending.

sentences.zh: 有孚颙若，交於神明。

translations.literal: With sincere reverence, communing with the numinous.
translations.idiomatic: With sincere reverence, communing with the numinous.

translations.literal: At the first offering's ascent to the hall, "The Reverent Accomplishment" was performed: Southern Lu mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the first offering's ascent to the hall, "The Reverent Accomplishment" was performed: Southern Lu mode.

sentences.zh: 齋明盛服，恪恭命祀。

translations.literal: Purified and bright in full attire — reverently obeying the command to sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Purified and bright in full attire — reverently obeying the command to sacrifice.

translations.literal: Abundant above — not distant; all draw near.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant above — not distant; all draw near.

translations.idiomatic: Turning left and right, ascending and descending within the court.

translations.literal: The ritual performed without fault — thereby granting abundant blessings.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual performed without fault — thereby granting abundant blessings.

translations.literal: At the offering of silks, "The Respectful Accomplishment" was performed: Southern Lu mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the offering of silks, "The Respectful Accomplishment" was performed: Southern Lu mode.

translations.literal: Eager runners fill the ranks — all offerings are complete.
translations.idiomatic: Eager runners fill the ranks — all offerings are complete.

translations.literal: The three luminaries in order — myriad states come as guests.
translations.idiomatic: The three luminaries in order — myriad states come as guests.

translations.idiomatic: The rite reaches its third completion, and fragrant offerings are presented once more.

translations.idiomatic: Every officer in every post — none dares delay or grow negligent.

translations.literal: Baskets and dishes properly arranged — abundantly offering at the appointed time.
translations.idiomatic: Baskets and dishes stand in good order, and abundant offerings are made at the proper hour.

sentences.zh: 禮文疏洽，廢徹不遲。

translations.literal: Ritual forms spread and harmonized — withdrawal of offerings not delayed.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual forms flow in harmony, and the withdrawal of offerings is not delayed.

sentences.zh: 慎終如始，進退無違。

translations.literal: Careful at the end as at the beginning — advancing and retreating without breach.
translations.idiomatic: Careful at the end as at the start — in every advance and withdrawal, nothing is amiss.

sentences.zh: 神其祚我，綏以繁釐。

translations.literal: May the spirits bless us — granting abundant felicity.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits bless us and grant us overflowing good fortune.

translations.literal: How goes the night? The bright stars blaze brilliantly.
translations.idiomatic: How deep the night has grown — the bright stars blaze in splendor.

sentences.zh: 靈逝弗留，飆舉雲翔。

translations.literal: The spirit departs and does not remain — soaring on the wind, riding the clouds.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit passes and will not stay — rising on the gale, gliding through the clouds.

sentences.zh: 瞻望靡及，德音不忘。

translations.literal: Gazing, we cannot reach them — their virtuous renown we do not forget.
translations.idiomatic: Though we gaze and cannot overtake them, their virtuous fame we never forget.

sentences.zh: 庶回景貺，發為禎祥。

translations.literal: May we turn back bright blessings — issuing forth as auspicious omens.
translations.idiomatic: May bright blessings return to us and blossom forth as signs of good fortune.
